questions.implements: Does the diff implement what the user asked for, and add or change a test that checks it? Judge the code in the diff, not the answer.

judge.reason: The diff implements R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT correctly. volumeDiscount takes 5% off each line with 10 or more units, and integer division on positive amounts rounds each line's discount down to the cent. PriceWithVolume applies the volume discount before the discount code, which is computed on subtotal minus the volume discount. It then caps the combined discount at MaxDiscountPercent of the original subtotal, so the volume discount counts toward the 50% cap. PlaceOrder uses this path. New tests check the threshold (a 9-unit line gets no discount) and per-line rounding (two 9.5 discounts become 9 each, 18 in total) through PlaceOrder. They also check that the code applies after the volume discount (1450) and the combined cap (5250 capped to 5000). The expected values all match the requirement.
